concepts_present.evidence_quote: Feature Pyramid Network ... a top-down architecture with lateral connections is developed for building high-level semantic feature maps at all scales.
We integrate FPN into the Faster R-CNN system.
Anchors are now defined to have a single scale per pyramid level.
Our base model is ResNet-50 / ResNet-101 with the C2-C5 stages.
FPN is plugged into RPN as a feature aggregator.
Standard NMS is used at inference.
On the COCO detection benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art results.

concepts_absent.rationale: FPN is not anchor-free; it provides multi-scale features for anchor-based RPN.
FPN paper uses cross-entropy; focal loss appears in the later RetinaNet paper that builds on FPN.
Detection-focused; mask is added by Mask R-CNN that uses FPN.
